source.title: TideLab invented Pine SMA 2 subset example

claim.attributed_summary: Invented Pine syntax fixture for deterministic frontend conformance; no market-performance claim.
claim.economic_rationale: None; this family checks deterministic strategy-package mechanics only.

interpretation.product_scope: One synthetic spot-like instrument and cash; no market candidate is selected.
interpretation.timeframe: One closed synthetic hourly bar per decision, with a next-hour hypothetical fill.
required_data: TideLab-authored complete synthetic hourly open and close bars.
required_capabilities: Synthetic long/cash target and deterministic next-open fill contract.
interpretation.entry: Closed synthetic hourly close above SMA(2) requests a long target.
interpretation.exit: Closed synthetic hourly close below SMA(2) requests cash.
interpretation.sizing: Fixed synthetic target fraction 40 percent; cash for the remainder.
interpretation.timing: Close-only signal; any hypothetical fill occurs no earlier than the next hourly open.
